visualCharacteristics.purpose: live list of the locale's Insights articles from the article index: category, tag or author overview with search, category filter, paging and total count
traits: result count left, search field and category select right
cards alternate text | image and image | text, 100px apart
tag chips, bold title, bold byline 'date | reading time | author', description, arrow link

contentPattern.structure: key | value rows, all optional: Category (path segment), Tag (articles:<id>), Author (lh/<slug>), Page size, Hide filter; optional label rows. The cards come from /{cc}/{ll}/articles/query-index.json.

usage: Insights category overviews (/de/en/articles/explore-the-world, explore-flying, highlights), tag pages (/de/en/articles/tags/munich) and author pages (/de/en/articles/authors/florian-tomberg).
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of Insights articles; articles need the importer's metadata (page-type article, category, tag-ids, author-id, publication-date, card-image).
